text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the Tenno Sho (Autumn) drew near, 
anticipation surged for the clash between 
Narita Brian and Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap declared outright that she would 
not yield victory. Narita Brian quietly 
stoked the flames of her fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Biwa Hayahide learned that 
Narita Brian was setting her sights on the 
Autumn Senior Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She held onto the hope that she might 
still make it in time for the end of the 
year.
